forms.description: Phase 2C blueprint: full welfare-relevant citizen profile. Common sections for everyone plus conditionally revealed type-specific sections (student, farmer, employed, self-employed, disability). Citizen types are NOT mutually exclusive - applicability is driven by answers and conditions, not citizen_type.
